# Example drafts, not approved work briefs

These Bible and Holmes files exercise the shared brief contract. Their tone, eras and depiction rules are test data, not owner-approved production policy. Merging a code or fixture PR does not approve them for generation.

The approved briefs are the committed `works/<work-id>/brief.json` files. The reading pass proposes each in a separate, one-file brief PR; the owner reviews each depiction rule and the ordered style set, and merging that PR records approval. Readiness is a separate gate.
